reels.title: Sheep and goats: what if only 5% of the people are saved?
reels.hook: Sheep or goat – which side are you on?
reels.why: A powerful image of the Last Judgment applied to one's own people and the speaker himself. The number and the sentence about a "second chance" stick in the mind.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: It is finished. There is no longer even an opportunity for a second chance.

reels.title: After 40 days of fasting you cannot say to Jesus „Goodbye God, ciao“
reels.hook: Did you finish fasting? That is where the trap begins
reels.why: A humorous, relatable scene („Goodbye God, ciao“) with clear practical advice on how to rest, and not give up.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: You cannot say to Jesus: "Jesus, now the 40-day fast has ended. Goodbye God, ciao."

cards.text: Did you finish fasting? That is where the trap begins

days of fasting – and what now?

reels.title: Heaven or a coffin forever: that is the choice
reels.why: The contrast between two vivid images, heaven and hell as a closed coffin, ends with a clear personal conclusion for the viewer.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: You should adapt your entire life to being saved.

cards.text: Two eternities. You choose now.
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
Grebenar imagines the moment of decision at the Last Judgment.
„You end up in hell as if someone put you in that coffin and you cannot get out of it.“

reels.title: Fasting hurts, but after it I feel light as a bird
reels.hook: What happens when you fast for a long time?
reels.why: Personal experience and concrete fruits of fasting („light as a bird“, less sleep) provide a practical and sincere message.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Well, my experience is when I fast long-term, I feel light as a bird.

cards.text: What happens when you fast for a long time?
Vladimir Grebenar · host, Ora et Labora
He speaks at the end of the 40-day fast of his prayer community.
„Fasting hurts. … but fasting brings grace, brings fruits.“
„When I fast long-term, I feel light as a bird.“

reels.title: A billion people on earth, and God looks only at Job
reels.hook: One man is enough for God
reels.why: A clear and encouraging insight with biblical examples (Job, Noah): one righteous man can turn everything around.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: Only one single person is enough, brothers and sisters, for everything to be turned around through him.

reels.title: Has your child taken the wrong path? Pray, fast, and accept
reels.hook: Has your child gone astray? Here is the answer
reels.why: A question that troubles many parents and a short, honest answer about prayer and respecting free will.
reels.speaker: Vladimir Grebenar
reels.quote: But you also must accept that after some time, if there is no change, that it is his the choice of his free will.
